name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on *all* PRs for two weeks first. This lets us measure its impact without risking real changes. The trade-off is slower feedback loops, but we avoid broken PRs or wasted reviews. After two weeks, we’ll know if it’s worth turning on fully.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode won’t catch PR-Agent’s worst flaw: false negatives. It normalizes them as "acceptable" because it never forces a real review—so broken code still merges, just slower. Instead, run a controlled A/B test: PR-Agent on half the PRs, human-only on the other, then compare defect rates. If the Agent’s false negatives spike, we’ll see it in the data, not after a two-week lag.
